"（三号楷体加粗）" specifies the value style.

Student-ID line. Leading "□" blocks plus "学号" form the fixed label with the embedded "□" as part of the literal label text. Colon is fixed separator. The 14 "×" characters represent the fill slot for the actual student ID (length variant lives in the value, not as a separate label).

Grade-major-class line. Leading "□" blocks plus the label form the fixed label. Colon is fixed separator. The value pattern "20××级×××（×）班" is the composite fill slot for grade, major, and class as a single value (matches author.cohort_class cardinality=one composite field).

Advisor line. Leading "□" blocks plus the label form the fixed label. Colon is fixed separator. The advisor name placeholder "×××" and the title placeholder "教授" are bound to advisor.name.zh and advisor.title respectively (separate fields in the vocabulary). The literal "□" is a full-width-space separator between the two fill values.

Department line. Leading "□" blocks plus "学院" form the fixed label. Colon is fixed separator. "××××学院" is the fill slot for the department full name. "（学院名用全称）" is a parenthetical template note about using the full department name; it is content guidance, not style, and should not appear in the clean filled cover.
Layout instruction specifying blank-line count above the location line; pure style note.
School location line. "湖南·长沙" is the fixed school location. The parenthetical specifies the font and size for the location text.
Submission date line. "提交日期" is the fixed label; colon is fixed separator. "20××年××月" is the fill slot for the actual submission year and month.
